adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained offset starting near index 476 with clear step-down in all axes, followed by a gradual recovery beginning ~518 and continuing to ~526. The interior (476–518) shows persistent displacement without return, while post-518 residuals show systematic drift back toward pre-offset levels—consistent with a temporary platform. P1 (475–526) captures full onset-to-return; P2 (476–518) ends before recovery begins and thus truncates the platform. Hypothesis P1 subtraction yields flat residuals only after ~526, confirming return is incomplete before then. Independent nuisance step at 461 does not affect this interval. Therefore only P1 represents a genuine temporary platform; P2 is subsumed and should be replaced.
